seo.title: Yordan Ivanov | Coaching for experienced data professionals
seo.description: I help experienced data professionals who already do a lead's job get their priorities agreed, their work seen and the title to match.

sections.title: You're already doing a lead's job without the title
sections.subtitle: If you're an experienced data professional in that spot, I coach you on getting your priorities agreed, your work seen and the title to match.

sections.title: Coaching on your own case
sections.description: If you want help with the promotion case you're writing or the stakeholder who keeps saying no, we work on it 1-on-1. I coach alongside my day job as Head of Data Engineering, and it starts with a free 30-minute discovery call where I don't pitch. Book it and tell me what you're stuck on.

sections.title: My free email course
sections.description: If you want your "not now" to hold and a yes from the people above you, start here. Over your first 10 days it covers how I rank requests and how I get buy-in for my most ambitious projects, among other things. After that, Data Gibberish comes twice a week. Join 5,000+ subscribers.

sections.heading: What readers say
sections.quote: This is why I follow Yordan's posts, it comes from experience, its valuable, and its real. Because its clearly written a bit hastily by a senior engineer and not by an AI.
